narrative.details: This is a contract for the assassination of Magistrate Henry Maleb.  It was sealed and stamped in red wax, using a distinctive signet ring.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Assassin's Contract to Magistrate Maleb in Southshore.
narrative.offerRewardText:
<Maleb inspects the contract.>

That explains the latest attack on Southshore. The Syndicate must be after me, just as they were the last magistrate!
narrative.requestItemsText: You look out of breath! Do you have something to report?
